argument_anchors.name: The tensed-knowledge challenge
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: A defender denies absolute presentness or argues one atemporal act knows every tensed fact through a non-successive access relation.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: The first response rejects a key premise and is a serious alternative; the second must explain access without either missing changing actuality or collapsing all times into one temporal present.
unresolved_issues: Neither A-theory nor B-theory settled here.
Direct modern defender originals and response chain remain coverage gaps.
Propositional and non-propositional knowledge need separate accounts.

argument_anchors.name: Timeless personhood and intentional responsiveness
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: The proposed timeless capacities may be nominal; responsiveness to genuinely new events seems to require new states.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Either justify whole-history reasons-sensitive dependence, or accept a temporal divine life with creation. Neither option is cost-free.
unresolved_issues: Craig’s timeless-without-creation scope is limited.
Transition into time must not posit a time before time.
Trinitarian illustration is an additional theological assumption, not universal-subject evidence.

argument_anchors.name: Whole-history preservation versus survival
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: An enlarged subject-history might include genuinely continuing subjectivity outside embodied succession.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: That is a distinct stronger hypothesis deserving assessment under an explicit identity relation; merely calling it inclusion does not establish it.
unresolved_issues: T13: bearer, death condition, numerical identity, continuation domain, memory and branching.

argument_anchors.name: Identity and physical realization
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: The account may capture reporting or causal role without phenomenal character.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Identity theorist denies two items remain to be bridged once identity is warranted; separate epistemic access need not add a property.
unresolved_issues: Does the identification capture the target?
What empirical/semantic premises warrant the identity?
Weak emergence needs a realization account and subject boundary.

argument_anchors.name: Experiential bases and subject constitution
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: Microexperiences plus physics may not necessitate another subject; palette and structure constraints are distinct.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: The complete base can include phenomenal relations; informational rather than geometrical structure may matter. Inconceivability/impossibility is not established.
unresolved_issues: Specify relation and boundaries without arbitrary selection.
Conceivability-to-possibility standard must match its use against physicalism.
Emergent macroexperience changes the constitutive model and restores causal/law costs.

argument_anchors.name: Naturalistic property dualism and causal/epistemic cost
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: Under closure and no overdetermination, distinct experiential influence threatens exclusion; epiphenomenalism threatens experience-based knowledge/reporting.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: PL1 appeals to lawful tracking and direct acquaintance without extra physical effects; PL2 instead questions closure and proposes interaction laws. Neither reply is simply a conservation-law refutation.
unresolved_issues: Why this mapping rather than another?
Would a tracking account secure truth/justification or only matching reports?
Interaction/substance variants lack inspected direct defender/reply chains in this packet.

argument_anchors.name: Dissociated cosmic idealism
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: An analogy to dissociation in embodied people does not establish cosmic subject division; calling brain activity an appearance can merely redescribe data.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Distinguish inaccessible contents from nonexistent contents and causal impingement from shared cognitive access; formulate one lawful shared environment rather than personal wishing.
unresolved_issues: Cosmic extension of analogy and clinical premises unverified.
Organism-scale boundary needs noncircular criterion and edge cases.
Specific laws and mapping not derived; shared substrate not automatically shared perceptions.

argument_anchors.name: Cosmic constitution versus plural idealism
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: One subject cannot be numerically identical to multiple mutually distinct subjects under ordinary identity logic.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Identity version relativizes access to modes; nonidentity version posits constitutive dependence. Plural idealism permits multiple basic subjects with lawful coordination.
unresolved_issues: Identity/mode view revises ordinary individuality.
Nonidentity grounding needs a sufficient principle.
Plural coordination and basic intersubject relations carry separate costs.
None establishes H-S or H-T.

argument_anchors.name: Psychological appropriation and a repaired continuity criterion
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: Memories may duplicate, disappear or presuppose ownership.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Project repair: overlapping causal links and a nonbranching clause avoid direct-memory transitivity failure; they still need independent justification.
unresolved_issues: Not all modern continuity accounts inspected; Parfit direct access failed.
Locke’s own theory is not identical to this repaired project model.

argument_anchors.name: Thinking animal and biological persistence
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: A transplanted cerebrum seems to carry the person; or the strict thinker is a soul/constituted subject.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Olson presses costs of denying organism thought or multiplying thinkers; psychological evidence/concern may be mistaken for constitution.
unresolved_issues: Unique-thinker and strict animal-thinking premises contested.
Animalism alone is not a complete theory of death, resurrection or animal persistence.

argument_anchors.name: Simple subject through qualitative change
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: Epistemic underdetermination does not entail an immaterial entity; deny further-fact premise or specify a physical/causal identity rule.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Charitable project reply: first-person numerical identity is not exhausted by descriptive similarity; the defender must argue that fact is real and immaterial, not merely unknowable.
unresolved_issues: Short essay does not resolve all technical objections.
A surviving soul and continuing experience require additional persistence/activation premises; simplicity is not immortality.

argument_anchors.name: Enlarged first-person history beyond bodily life
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: The asserted ownership/extension may restate survival; a universal knower can preserve a finite life without the person continuing.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Treat subjectivity and individuation as substantive ontology with identifiable constraints; this blocks dismissal by definition but adds explanatory/evidential costs.
unresolved_issues: No observation here establishes enlarged history.
Strict organism criterion rejects disembodied extension unless same-organism relation defended.
Timeless individual model must explain non-successive awareness; the temporal-individual model does not solve that separate issue.

argument_anchors.name: Temporal phenomenology under competing interpretations
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: Survival interpretation: coherent first-person reports and striking information may reveal real access beyond the body; instruments may miss their distinctiveness.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Ordinary alternative has demonstrated drug-context overlap, while the survival reply correctly notes that inducing a resemblance need not explain a given case. Seek prospective, independently scored information and resolved timing; separately ask what identity relation it supports.
unresolved_issues: No same-mechanism conclusion; no inference of equal support.
No result here crosses irreversible bodily death under H-S.

argument_anchors.name: Enduring significance: necessity versus enhancement
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: Finite goods may retain value even when no one later remembers; endless continuation may damage what mattered.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: A defender can argue continued shared life is an additional relational good, not merely a record, while defending separately the stronger non-loss requirement.
unresolved_issues: Value ordering; whose goods; identity; extent of duration; no inferred actual survival

argument_anchors.name: Finite value with an acknowledged cosmic remainder
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: A meaningful episode may still lack an ultimately worthwhile setting; all loss can defeat the hoped-for relationship to a larger whole.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Distinguish missing further goods from nonexistence of prior goods; do not claim this answers the larger purpose question.
unresolved_issues: Ground of objective value; relation of local to whole-life value; criterion of ultimate significance

argument_anchors.name: Williams on categorical desire and immortal life, with Fischer’s reply
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: Fischer allows varied activities, appropriately spaced repeatable pleasures, and acceptable character development; absorbed attention need not eliminate ownership. These contest inevitable exhaustion and indiscriminate identity-loss claims.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: A strengthened Williams-side response asks whether renewal preserves genuine engagement and prospective reasons rather than simply suppressing awareness of impoverishment. Occasional pleasantness does not settle that question, and every experience being owned does not by itself establish an adequate relation to present aims.
unresolved_issues: Whether human categorical projects necessarily exhaust under all relevant immortal arrangements
Whether relational development can renew motivation while preserving identity and appropriate concern
Fischer’s repeatability/variety response does not alone establish objective worth or infinite resources
Williams addresses endless human life; application to strict timeless foundation or transformed persons needs additional premises

argument_anchors.name: Cosmic purpose and normative worth
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: Arbitrary or harmful ends would still be purposes; a timeless agent model owes coherent intention; designer premises remain unsupported.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Specify a loving creator-person relation and whole-history intention, or temporal agency; assess these with the same standards as rival primitive laws and value commitments.
unresolved_issues: Actual intention; agency model; normative foundation; domain; goodness and authority deferred

argument_anchors.name: Consciousness-factory discrimination
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: Unknown goals/resources can accommodate almost any outcome; conscious observers necessarily observe from a conscious perspective.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Precommit to independent goals, inclusion rules and feasible alternatives; compare the same data across intentional, impersonal-teleological and incidental models.
unresolved_issues: No population survey or likelihoods; no completed test; suffering analysis deferred to T15

argument_anchors.name: From conscious value to moral authority
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: Calling a being good or creative may presuppose the normativity being explained; unity and sanctions can yield only self-interest.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Grounding need not be a definition or a temporal production: a defensible identity/constitution account can terminate explanation in a necessary good and a legitimate relation. This reply still owes warrant for that identity and relation.
unresolved_issues: No derivation of impartiality from mere awareness.
No independent authority proof in inspected Craig transcript.
No assumption that divine commands all have identical modal status.

argument_anchors.name: Secular moral objectivity and its explanatory costs
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: A fully informed egoist may still reject impartiality; reliable preference explanation might explain moral belief while omitting moral authority.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Separate truth and applicability from the agent’s motivation; evaluate whether the proposed identity explains correction, practical criticism and disagreement. Other secular accounts can instead take categorical reasons or rational agency as basic, with their own costs.
unresolved_issues: Naturalism is not a proof from evolution.
Constructivism and non-natural realism reconstructed in matrix but no decisive original defender inspected.
Aggregative criterion may face rights, comparability and determinate-idealization objections.

argument_anchors.name: Suffering as evidence against specified perfect governance
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: Our sample of goods, causal relations and feasible worlds may be too limited to assess what an omniscient being could justifiably permit.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Finite limits do not automatically erase all evidence; compare what each hypothesis actually leads us to expect and what independently supports claimed limitations. Theistic countergrounds can rationally matter.
unresolved_issues: No measured prevalence or likelihood supplied.
A hypothetical animal does not establish an actual event.
Free-will and soul-making originals beyond the inspected discussions remain gaps.

argument_anchors.name: Restoration of persons and justification of harm
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: A later good may quiet grief without making the original injustice permissible; one person’s reconciliation cannot speak for another victim.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: The strongest version addresses each victim and distinguishes redemption from approval of wrongdoing; an internal consistency defense may use its own independently specified goods without claiming their actual existence is thereby proved.
unresolved_issues: The possibility and worth of divine intimacy remain contested.
Identity and temporal manifestation must be specified.
Adams’s later clarifications and reply to Sutherland not inspected.

argument_anchors.name: Nonresistant nonbelief and relationship
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: Howard-Snyder distinguishes a desire for relationship now from an overriding reason to enable it now. Even a well-disposed inculpable seeker might benefit from owning or refining the disposition to love. He offers defeasible prima facie reasons and epistemic caution, not proof of actual divine reasons.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Project comparison: a possible counterfactual disposition is not automatically resistance causing present nonbelief. Ask whether improving love can occur in an available relationship, and whether delaying access is no worse than other means once the lost relationship is counted. A defender may contest that comparison or our knowledge of it. Note18 and reply4 identify limits to this particular defense; no blanket victory is inferred.
unresolved_issues: The1996reply addresses earlier Schellenberg; the2025argument emphasizes nonresistance causally relevant to nonbelief. Exact earlier book/reply exchange not inspected.
A reason to delay developing a relationship does not automatically explain withholding the conditions of being open to one; this is the contested bridge.
No observed distribution of dispositions or actual divine permission reasons.
Availability, fittingness and the no-worse-alternative criterion remain disputed.

argument_anchors.name: Goodness, authority and dependence across the package
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: Restricting knowledge of unknown goods need not undermine simple moral knowledge; criticism can demand unreasonable omniscience of the defender.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Use local rather than blanket skepticism and name what remains knowable; test whether the positive and negative inferences genuinely rely on the same inaccessible domain.
unresolved_issues: No equal-support verdict.
Removing retrospective NDE claims leaves conceptual distinctions but no new survival evidence.
Rejecting moral realism changes the moral argument and some evil formulations; internal inconsistency arguments can still use an opponent’s commitments.

argument_anchors.name: Dentures conditional anomalous-perception argument
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: Single-witness retrospective timing and information control are insufficient to establish those premises.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Unusual shelf details and pre-Thumper removal deserve testing; a generic ordinary possibility does not erase the report.
unresolved_issues: No defensible numerical likelihood ratio or posterior; dependence on shared case narratives retained.

argument_anchors.name: Reynolds conditional anomalous-perception argument
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: Checkable claims occur outside the alleged standstill interval, and drug/monitoring/access conditions are incompletely inspected.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Carter’s technical details and visual specificity challenge simplistic hearing reconstructions; neither party has supplied the decisive controlled comparison here.
unresolved_issues: No defensible numerical likelihood ratio or posterior; dependence on shared case narratives retained.

argument_anchors.name: Limit of survival and cosmic extrapolation
argument_anchors.strongest_objection: A verified brain-independent episode could nevertheless be relevant to models permitting personal survival.
argument_anchors.strongest_reply: Relevance is retained conditionally; irreversible death, numerical identity, universal subjecthood, purpose and normative relations require additional premises.
unresolved_issues: No defensible numerical likelihood ratio or posterior; dependence on shared case narratives retained.

dependence_clusters.relation: One Neal reporting chain; rescue and ICU phases distinguished. Multiple books/interviews are retellings, not independent NDE confirmations.
dependence_clusters.synthesis_rule: Retain different phase content but cluster all testimony under Neal1999; published recollection of a witness conversation is not an independently inspected witness.

dependence_clusters.relation: Alexander illness/recovery share patient and narrative. Anonymous clinical case identification through self-attribution is not another patient. Family interviews and patient-reviewed chart-review article add documentary roles, not new NDEs.
dependence_clusters.synthesis_rule: Cluster common event and distinguish contemporaneous raw observation from later author/reporter accounts; preserve disputes rather than count advocates/critics as votes.

dependence_clusters.relation: AWARE I separate study; AWARE II prospective and selected community arms distinct ascertainment, one article. Compilation excerpt and full original are linked representations.
dependence_clusters.synthesis_rule: Do not add community experiences to prospective numerator/denominator or multiply excerpt/full text; do not assume all exposed shelves/CPR deployments yielded interviewed target trials.

dependence_clusters.relation: Dutch follow-ups reuse cohort. Dentures dossier links documentary anecdote printed in cohort paper; a cohort-membership match was not established.
dependence_clusters.synthesis_rule: Never add dentures to cohort denominator, call it a new prospective hit, or deduplicate a claimed cohort participant without identity evidence. Repeat resuscitations, persons and follow-up interviews differ.

dependence_clusters.relation: Distinct Bede narratives share literary/redaction/translation lineage. Same duplicate_group string does not establish same narrated person/event.
dependence_clusters.synthesis_rule: Keep distinct narratives with shared source dependence; none is a clinical control or independent manuscript witness.

dependence_clusters.relation: Indian collection and Japanese reanalysis are different sources; Japanese preliminary273 literature pool is not273 directly inspected interviews. Earlier Western comparisons are not matched new observations.
dependence_clusters.synthesis_rule: Do not pool differently prompted categories, blanks or reused comparative tables; original-language/interview uncertainty remains.

dependence_clusters.relation: IANDS/Liège recruitment and selected retrospective comparison may overlap; identity unknown. T13 reuses Greyson1990 instrument/sample already in T08; DMT/placebo conditions repeat13 volunteers.
dependence_clusters.synthesis_rule: Unknown overlap is neither disjointness nor confirmed duplication; show non-additively. Temporal-item reanalysis adds a question, not a new sample. Shared group strings mark risk, not exact event identity.

dependence_clusters.relation: Macaque stimulation trials/awake data, shared human anesthesia/sleep participants, and one stimulated patient include repeated observations.
dependence_clusters.synthesis_rule: Keep patient/animal/trial/run units; do not call state contrasts independent cohorts. Human content stimulation and animal arousal evidence have different experiential interpretations.

dependence_clusters.relation: COGITATE protocol, main paper, supplement, critique and correction concern shared predictions/results.
dependence_clusters.synthesis_rule: One experiment can challenge several predictions; multiple papers are not replications. Respect exact phase/amplitude and preregistered/exploratory distinctions; a wording error does not dismiss all criticism.

dependence_clusters.relation: Dentures witness chain returns to TG; K.B. is messenger. Reynolds sources reuse Sabom/technical communications and propositions about one surgery.
dependence_clusters.synthesis_rule: Advocate/critic/reply multiplicity is not event multiplicity. Keep reported checkable observations outside standstill separate from untime-locked relatives/light segment. Possible ordinary explanations remain unproven causes.

dependence_clusters.relation: Facing Up and Papineau reused; three Chalmers originals overlap in explanatory/modality commitments. Combination/decomposition arguments address related grounding burdens.
dependence_clusters.synthesis_rule: Credit each distinct inference only once for its actual premise contribution. An attribution that one author asserts P and another denies P is argument opposition, not contradictory attribution evidence.

dependence_clusters.relation: PSR, explanatory completeness, necessary-ground and primitive-stopping assumptions recur in existence, mind and time maps.
dependence_clusters.synthesis_rule: Do not multiply conclusions as independent observations. Test rejection of global PSR and epistemic-to-modal bridge separately; no asymmetric demand only consciousness primitives explain themselves.

dependence_clusters.relation: Identity continuity supports preservation/survival and proposed worthwhile restoration. Enduring value, objective worth and moral authority are distinct recurring normative bridges.
dependence_clusters.synthesis_rule: Restoration assumed to defend goodness is not new evidence for survival; survival desired for meaning is not evidence it occurs. Fix identity before evaluating same-person benefit, and do not circularly infer goodness from a life-valuing designer assumed by fine-tuning.

dependence_clusters.relation: A common experiential ground may unify several explananda if actual grounding, individuation, intention, preservation and normative bridges work.
dependence_clusters.synthesis_rule: Unification may have explanatory value without independence multiplication. Count added bridge commitments and empirical constraints symmetrically; a conceptual relation is not a new observation.

evidence_counts_policy: No pooled sample, event, paper or premise vote. External inspection count for T16=0.
